review.note: Drafted by the assistant in M44b under the owner's dated exception, from the sources named and not from a reading of them; the argument is the thing to check, not only the dates.

explanation: The war is why the United States made peace with Japan in 1951 and on those terms. The war turned occupied Japan into the base it was fought from and the workshop that supplied it. Washington valued an ally more than reparations or restrictions. Dulles negotiated the peace treaty and the security treaty together while the fighting went on. The edge claims the timing and the mild terms. A peace with Japan would have come in any case.
